pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with varying spatial area. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients and soft-angled vertices due to image resolution and texture.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, light-toned grid with primary triradiate and tetraradiate junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform, maintaining high connectivity across the flank and lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the neck-to-shoulder transition. Individual hair tufts create a subtly jagged 1D silhouette against the background.
